homePageDescription.message: Your SmartTab Organizer dashboard: pinned sessions, shortcuts, and activity.

homepageHeroOnboardingSubtitle.message: Group your tabs by domain, deduplicate automatically, and save your work sessions. Everything stays on your machine, with no cloud and no AI.

homepageQuickOrganizeDesc.message: Group and deduplicate in one click

homepageTipsT1Text.message: Middle-click or right-click opens the new tab in the right group automatically when the domain is configured.

homepageTipsT2Text.message: Pin a session to restore it in one click from the popup.

homepageTipsT3Text.message: The Organize tabs button deduplicates and then groups all open tabs at once.

homepageTipsT4Text.message: Import a themed pack (Developer, Productivity, etc.) to configure several domains at once instead of creating each rule by hand.

homepageTipsT5Text.message: Rules can be disabled individually without being deleted.

homepageTipsT6Text.message: A rule can extract the group name from the page title using a capturing regular expression.

homepageTipsT7Text.message: Drag and drop your rules to set priority: the first rule that matches a domain wins.

homepageTipsT8Text.message: Each rule can enforce a Chrome color on the group it creates, so you can spot the context at a glance.

homepageTipsT9Text.message: Enable, disable, or delete several rules at once thanks to the grouped selection in the list.

homepageTipsT10Text.message: Document what a rule does by adding a note. Very handy for non-trivial regexes.

homepageTipsT11Text.message: Pick from the built-in presets (numeric ID, content in brackets, UUID, Google Search, GitHub Search, Reddit) instead of writing a regex from scratch.

homepageTipsT12Text.message: Tag a rule with a NEW, WARNING, or DELETED badge to spot it in the list while iterating on your configuration.

homepageTipsT13Text.message: The rule creation wizard guides you step by step: identity, group name capture, options, then summary before validation.

homepageTipsT14Text.message: Exact URL, normalized URL (ignored parameters removed), or inclusion: pick the tolerance level that suits you.

homepageTipsT15Text.message: When a duplicate is detected, you decide who survives: the tab already grouped, the oldest one, or the newest one.

homepageTipsT16Text.message: Each rule can define its own list of URL parameters to ignore for deduplication (with wildcard utm_*), perfect for marketing tracking links.

homepageTipsT17Text.message: An Undo notification appears after every duplicate closure. The tab is restored to its original group.

homepageTipsT18Text.message: Certain rules (web terminals, multi-instance dashboards) can disable dedup while still being grouped.

homepageTipsT19Text.message: The Organize button chains dedup then grouping: you always start from a clean slate.

homepageTipsT20Text.message: When saving a session, uncheck the tabs you don't want to include.

homepageTipsT21Text.message: A saved session remains editable: rename tabs, remove entries, change group names.

homepageTipsT22Text.message: The wizard detects tabs or groups already open and offers the current window, a new window, or a full replacement.

homepageTipsT23Text.message: When you collapse a group in the editor, the state is remembered: your layout is restored on reopen.

homepageTipsT24Text.message: Hover a session card to see tab count, dates, and description without clicking.

homepageTipsT25Text.message: Add a free-form description to a session to remember the context (sprint, release, research).

homepageTipsT26Text.message: A profile pins a session to a window. Save and restore happen automatically in the right place.

homepageTipsT27Text.message: Each workspace has its own rules, sessions, settings, and statistics. Perfect for separating personal and work contexts.

homepageTipsT28Text.message: The selector at the bottom of the sidebar lets you change workspace without reloading the extension.

homepageTipsT29Text.message: Each workspace can have its own accent color to visually signal the active context.

homepageTipsT30Text.message: Export an entire workspace (rules, sessions, stats history) in a single JSON file, ready to be restored elsewhere.

homepageTipsT31Text.message: No file required: paste JSON directly to import rules or sessions.

homepageTipsT32Text.message: On import, each entry is labeled new, identical (skipped), or in conflict (to resolve manually).

homepageTipsT33Text.message: Add an optional note to an export to trace its origin (machine, date, team).

homepageTipsT34Text.message: All imports go through Zod. A malformed JSON is rejected before anything is written to storage.

homepageTipsT35Text.message: Press ? in the popup to open the shortcuts panel without leaving your task.

homepageTipsT36Text.message: On the Options page, the sequences m+h, m+r, m+s, m+t, m+i open Home, Rules, Sessions, Stats, Import/Export.

homepageTipsT37Text.message: A single key: s saves, r restores, o organizes, p opens the options page.

homepageTipsT38Text.message: Ctrl+Shift+1 opens the popup; from there press O to organize or S to save the current window. Assign your own shortcuts in chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

homepageTipsT39Text.message: Press / to focus the search bar of a list. Esc clears it.

homepageTipsT40Text.message: The numbers on the home page are links. Click to jump straight to the matching detailed view.

homepageTipsT41Text.message: Statistics are isolated per workspace: each space keeps its own history.

homepageTipsT42Text.message: The theme button in the header switches between light, dark, and system. The choice is remembered across browser sessions.

homepageTipsT43Text.message: The extension speaks French, English, and Spanish. The language follows the browser's.

homepageTipsT44Text.message: When a button is disabled, it stays reachable by keyboard and explains why through a tooltip.
